name: Homelands
description: The region of Ulgrotha protected from outsiders by Feroz's Ban.

description_citations.text: "Autumn Willow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daria fears the Homelands are lost without Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: "Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost."

citation.text: Feroz's Ban (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Autumn Willow grows from a simple forest spirit into a sentient being with physical form because of the mana backed up by Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: the Autumn Willow grew incredibly powerful and achieved sentience and physical form

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the evening Feroz died, the Autumn Willow has a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.
timeline.quote: On the evening that Feroz died, the Autumn Willow had a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir .

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Feroz's Ban begins to fail, the Autumn Willow feels her sustaining energies fade and agonizes over restarting the plane's mana channels at the cost of all creatures in the Homelands.
timeline.quote: When Feroz's Ban started to fail, she felt the energies that sustained her begin to fade.

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The land whose spirit is tied to Serra's.
